items: AI readiness covers the whole stack: talent, quality data, affordable infrastructure, enabling policy and real adoption by businesses.
Singapore and China lead the region, with Singapore setting frameworks others may adopt and China scaling fast under strong state support.
South Korea, Japan and India are following with distinct bets on AI hardware, creative industries and broad developer talent, while Southeast Asia's progress is mixed.
If you're scaling AI, base operations where infrastructure and regulation are stable, partner with local AI projects and invest in upskilling your team.
